Netted Tissue Fabric.short: Exquisite Netted Tissue Fabric featuring shimmering sheer texture and elegant metallic weave.
Netted Tissue Fabric.full: Premium unstitched Netted Tissue Fabric (1.0m to 1.2m cut). High-grade lightweight netted sheer texture with rich borders, offering effortless drape and luxurious bridal appeal.

Semi silk fabric.short: Lustrous Semi Silk Fabric with soft texture, traditional luster, and rich zari finish.
Semi silk fabric.full: Fine unstitched Semi Silk Fabric (1.0m to 1.2m cut). Offers the rich shine of pure silk with enhanced durability and smooth comfort for grand celebrations.

Tissue fabric.short: Ultra-rich metallic Tissue Fabric with glowing sheen and delicate artisan weaving.
Tissue fabric.full: Exclusive unstitched Tissue Fabric material (1.0m to 1.2m cut). Signature golden/silver metallic sheen suitable for heavy designer blouse patterns.
